text: Security is a crucial part of web development. First, websites should use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and servers. Second, strong authentication helps ensure that only the right people can access accounts and sensitive information. Third, developers must validate all user input to prevent attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Common vulnerabilities like weak passwords, unpatched software, and misconfigured servers can put both users and businesses at risk. By following security best practices, developers can build safer websites and protect user data from cyber threats.
